Game Overview

In Draw Weapon - Fight Party, the core idea is straightforward: unleash your creativity in Draw Weapon Fight Party. Design unique weapons with limited ink and enter thrilling 3D arenas. Strategize and skillfully push opponents off platforms. Unlock and upgrade weapons to enhance your combat style and dominate the competition in this exhilarating showdown. Become the master of custom-crafted chaos!
